tour: 40 free tools. Start without signing up.
Search a task, then choose its tool card.
Upload a photo or use the built-in sample.
Open Help for this tool for steps, examples, and limits.
compress: Open Compress images. Try a sample photo to practise.
Enter 100 KB and choose JPG as the output format.
Select Compress photo. Check the preview and file size.
Choose Download photo. Your result stays on your device.
resize: Open Resize images with a photo or the built-in sample.
Keep the aspect ratio locked. Set Width to 800 pixels.
Select Resize photo and check the output dimensions.
Choose Download photo to keep your resized image.
